verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA code authenticator, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-authored automations is outside its product category. The evidence offers only adjacent items: a CLI for automatic backups of codes and a trash for recovering deleted codes. Neither is an automation system with versions, review, or rollback, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
